title: Daily default stochastic 5-3-3 K-D range-acceleration long/cash timing
thesis: When a completed-day BTC close is rising inside its latest five-day high-low range faster than its three-day smoothed signal line, short-horizon range-position acceleration may persist strongly enough that a causal next-open long/cash policy preserves material upside while avoiding enough adverse paths to improve fee-adjusted risk-adjusted performance over full-capital buy-and-hold.
mechanism: For every complete UTC day, compute FastK from close location inside the latest five complete-day high-low range, map a flat range to zero, average the latest three FastK values into SlowK, and average the latest three SlowK values into SlowD. The strategy is fully long BTC when completed-day SlowK minus SlowD is strictly above a frozen threshold and otherwise holds zero-yield cash, with state changes executed at the next H1 open.
economic_rationale: Default stochastic 5-3-3 measures smoothed range-position acceleration rather than return magnitude, extreme age or a price breakout. The mechanism is useful only if the fixed zero K-D boundary retains material upside after costs while reducing drawdown and improving Calmar with broad annual and symmetric negative-10 and positive-10 neighbor support.
